event_name: Nonexistence of a finite projective plane of order 10

sources.title: The Non-Existence of Finite Projective Planes of Order 10
evidence_supported: The final nonexistence result was published in 1989.
The result is attributed to Lam, Thiel, and Swiercz.
The publication presents the finite projective-plane order-10 problem as resolved by the completed search.

evidence_supported: A computer search had already eliminated the oval configuration by 1983.
